# U.S. Food and Drug Administration

> The FDA protects public health by regulating drugs, devices, food safety, cosmetics, and biologics through industry systems, compliance frameworks, and regulatory oversight.

The FDA is the primary federal agency responsible for ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products, medical devices, food supplies, and cosmetics in the United States. The agency maintains multiple industry systems and certification platforms to facilitate regulatory compliance and import/export operations.

## Key Topics

- FDA Industry Systems
- Regulatory Compliance
- Facility Registration
- Import/Export Certification
- Drug Approval
- Medical Devices
- Food Supply Security
- Biologics Export
- Prior Notice Submission
- Product Recalls
- Adverse Events Reporting
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
- Bioterrorism Act of 2002
- Import Oversight

## FDA Industry Systems & Portals

- [FDA Industry Systems](https://www.access.fda.gov/): FDA Industry Systems portal for facility registration, import/export, and regulatory compliance
- [U.S. Food and Drug Administration](https://fda.gov/): FDA homepage: public health protection for drugs, devices, food safety, and cosmetics
